title: FTX App Earn
notes: Archived first-party support page for the FTX App Earn program. Used to establish that the FTX-branded mobile product paid yield on supported balances and to preserve the historical product identity.

title: Account Balances and Transactions
notes: Current FTX claims support states that balances and transaction histories are reflected through 11 November 2022 and include amounts earned from staking or participation in the Earn program. It also states that account data are read-only.

title: FTX Receives Court Approval for First Day Motions
notes: FTX-provided release states that FTX Trading Ltd. and affiliated debtors filed Chapter 11 petitions on 11 November 2022 and identifies Kroll as the official claims agent.

title: FTX Commences Initial Distributions to Convenience Class and Sets Next Distribution
notes: FTX-provided release confirms that initial bankruptcy-plan distributions commenced on 18 February 2025 for eligible allowed Convenience Class claims. It is not product-specific recovery evidence for FTX Earn.

title: Distributions Dashboard FAQs
notes: Current FTX support describes ongoing claim reconciliation and July 2026 distribution eligibility. Distribution status depends on allowed claim status, jurisdiction, KYC, tax and provider requirements; these conditions prevent CYA from assigning one universal FTX Earn recovery result.
